title: DeepContrail: contrail detection and segmentation in satellite imagery
description: Open-source library for contrail detection in satellite imagery. Version 0.1.0 covers semantic segmentation of contrails in GOES-16 ABI imagery (dataset format and validation, training, test-time augmentation, pretrained models) and a preview of instance segmentation, with a converter for the OpenContrails dataset. The pretrained model is published on the Hugging Face Hub as eurocontrol-asu/deepcontrail-segmentation.
